description:
Type gate-run ids from creation to storage, so run records are addressed through one infallible path constructor.

## Background

`GateRunResult.run_id` is a `String` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:941`), and `IssueStore::load_gate_run_result(run_id: &str)` (`storage/mod.rs:262`) takes a raw id. Run ids are validated only by `gate_run_result_relative_path` (`repository_state/mutation.rs:512-520`), which returns a `Result`; `gate-runs/{run_id}` is also spelled at `mutation.rs:535` and `storage/gate_runs.rs:34`. Run ids are allocated from the mutation context (`commands/gate_check.rs:871`, `storage/gate_runs.rs:33`, `mutation.rs:1074`). Drafts set `run_id: String::new()` (`gate_execution.rs:160`, `commands/gate_check.rs:41,1204`), and the finalizer assigns the id (`mutation.rs:1074-1076`). `GateVerdictOrigin::Reused` and the server's gate-run route (`crates/server/src/routes.rs:910`) carry run ids as strings. Every recorded run id in this repository is a canonical UUID.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `domain::identity::GateRunId` accepts only canonical UUIDs and serializes as a plain string.
- [hard] REQ-02: The mutation context derives gate-run ids as `GateRunId` through a dedicated accessor.
- [hard] REQ-03: `GateRunResult.run_id`, `GateVerdictOrigin::Reused` and `load_gate_run_result` use `GateRunId`, and the server parses its run-id path parameter once.
- [hard] REQ-04: Gate-run drafts carry their pre-derived run id. No empty run id exists, and the finalizer no longer assigns one.
- [hard] REQ-05: `VirtualPath::gate_run_record(&GateRunId)` is infallible and is the only builder of a gate-run record path, current-format recorded gate runs in this repository load and re-serialize byte-identically, and every other stored gate-run record decodes and reproduces its id fields.
title: Gate runs are identified by a validated GateRunId
